_discovery.describe: Interactive AI chat interface for conversing with LLM models. Supports multiple model providers and conversation contexts. Real-time streaming responses with markdown rendering. Includes conversation history and context management. Processing time varies by model and response length (~2-10 seconds). Requires LLM API access (OpenAI, Anthropic, or local models).
